title: bpjs_info (SCHEMA.md v4): BPJS Kesehatan / JKN status of a place
description: Structured, user-facing BPJS status. The raw `bpjs` text stays as evidence. Private archive notes (catatan_internal or any key containing 'internal') are never stored in this public repo; scripts/migrate-from-store.py --fields strips them and additionalProperties:false rejects them. No phone numbers in catatan_display (scripts/validate.py).

status.description: ya = accepted; sebagian = only some polis/services; tidak = a source says not accepted; tidak_relevan = not a health facility; belum_diketahui = no source either way (never guess).

rujukan.description: true = needs a referral from faskes tingkat 1 (FKTP); null = unknown or not applicable.

catatan_display.description: Short Indonesian, user-facing note. No phone numbers.
